claim.supported_scope: Seeded nonparametric case bootstrap with 1,000 through 10,000 raw-data resamples and complete refits of accepted single-group continuous reflective cbsem_ml_v1 CFA or recursive SEM models.
claim.estimand: The empirical case-resampling distribution, bootstrap standard error, and two-sided percentile interval for each supported free CB-SEM parameter.
assumptions: The original cbsem_ml_v1 fit is converged, identified, finite, and admissible.
Rows are independent sampling units and each replicate resamples n complete rows with replacement before recomputing moments and refitting.
At least max(1000, ceil(0.90 B)) requested replicates converge to admissible estimates under the frozen optimizer contract.
exclusions: Ordinal/WLSMV, robust, FIML, clustered, multilevel, parametric, BCa, studentized, and automatic model-modification bootstrap are excluded from this standalone capability.
Group-stratified or LMS refits may reuse the protocol only when separately qualified under cbsem_multigroup_v2 or cbsem_moderator_v1; those outputs are not standalone v2 evidence.
Bollen-Stine null-transformed fit inference is distinct, and the cbsem_bootstrap_v1 normal-interval preview is not a bootstrap and cannot be promoted or relabeled as v2.
warnings: Bootstrap validity depends on independent representative rows and stable admissible refits.
All failed replicates and their reasons remain visible; reaching a usable threshold does not erase them.

references.citation: Efron (1979), Bootstrap Methods: Another Look at the Jackknife, DOI 10.1214/aos/1176344552
Bollen and Stine (1992), Bootstrapping Goodness-of-Fit Measures in Structural Equation Models, DOI 10.1177/0049124192021002004
Independent Python case-resampling and full-refit CB-SEM bootstrap reference

simulations.design: Supported CFA and recursive SEM models across sample size, loading/path magnitude, normal and moderately nonnormal continuous data, and optimizer stress.
simulations.seed_policy: Frozen independent data-generation and replicate streams indexed by scenario, replicate, and bootstrap index.
simulations.acceptance_rule: Bias and coverage must meet preregistered Monte Carlo limits, every failed replicate must be counted, and payloads below the usable threshold must emit no interval.

simulations.design: Singular resamples, Heywood cases, nonconvergence, cancellation, and threshold-boundary cases.
simulations.seed_policy: Frozen adversarial fixtures plus deterministic replicate streams.
simulations.acceptance_rule: Every failure class and threshold decision must match the contract, and same-seed retry must reproduce uninterrupted output.

boundaries.case: One or more resamples have singular covariance, nonconvergence, non-finite estimates, or inadmissible variances.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Each replicate is reason-coded and counted; inference is emitted only if the frozen usable threshold is met.

boundaries.case: The base model uses an unqualified estimator, group design, FIML, clustering, interaction, or requested B outside 1,000 through 10,000.
Input rows are permuted while stable row identities and the seed-to-identity sampling rule are preserved.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Mapped resamples, estimates, failures, and intervals remain invariant.

boundaries.case: The same data, model, settings, and seed execute with different worker counts.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Replicate samples, fits, failures, and summaries are exactly equal.

boundaries.case: A sampled row set, replicate estimate, failure, interval, seed, threshold, or method identity is changed.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Strict project validation rejects the archive.

tamper_tests.expected_behavior: Reject an archive whose identity differs from CB-SEM bootstrap v2.
Reject a result relabeled from cbsem_bootstrap_v1 or another method.
Reject resamples whose base dataset fingerprint differs from saved input.
Reject an archive entry whose recipe, replicate, or result checksum differs.
Reject duplicate keys, unknown fields, invalid counts, non-finite estimates, unsorted quantiles, or inconsistent failures.
Never reinterpret analytical estimate plus or minus 1.96 standard errors from cbsem_bootstrap_v1 as resampling evidence.

persistence.legacy_policy: The cbsem_bootstrap_v1 preview remains explicitly experimental and is permanently ineligible for v2 evidence or migration.

applicability_blockers: Original fit not converged or admissible
native.gui_cli_parity_rule: GUI and CLI must produce identical worker-independent replicate streams, fits, failures, and bootstrap summaries for the same recipe and seed.
accessibility_rules: Interval and failure visuals have equivalent accessible tables.
Unavailable inference, failed counts, and warnings are communicated without color alone.
